preconditions: A single long loop is measured at II=1 and dominates latency.
Two contiguous input arrays and arithmetic resource headroom are available.
entries.action: Add only #pragma HLS UNROLL factor=2 to the measured loop.
entries.expected_signal: On the public U55C run, latency fell from 1027 to 515 cycles and Q_HW improved from 0.750000 to 0.766600.
contraindications: Do not apply to a dynamic or recurrence-limited loop.
Do not increase the factor without a new Q_HW measurement.

preconditions: The current best already uses UNROLL factor=2 on the long II=1 loop.
A larger factor is proposed without a new bottleneck.
entries.action: Do not replace the accepted factor=2 directive with factor=4.
entries.expected_signal: Avoid the measured regression from Q_HW 0.766600 to 0.726200.
contraindications: This case does not prohibit factor=2 on an otherwise compatible baseline.
Do not generalize across incompatible loop structure, target, or tool version.

preconditions: A 256-iteration popcount reduction is the measured latency bottleneck.
The loop has no memory arrays and sufficient LUT headroom for partial unrolling.
entries.action: Add only #pragma HLS UNROLL factor=4 to the measured popcount loop.
entries.expected_signal: On the public U55C run, latency fell from 257 to 18 cycles and Q_HW improved from 0.750000 to 0.859400.
contraindications: Do not apply to a non-popcount reduction or a loop with incompatible trip count.
Do not increase the factor without a new Q_HW measurement.

preconditions: The current source is a single 256-iteration popcount loop.
A source restructure is proposed without a measured architectural bottleneck.
entries.action: Avoid an unstructured source rewrite; prefer the measured loop-local UNROLL factor=4 action.
entries.expected_signal: Avoid repeating the public candidate that left Q_HW unchanged at 0.750000.
contraindications: This case does not prohibit the measured loop-local UNROLL action.
Do not generalize to a non-popcount task.
